build_definition.frames: round 1's switch rule output, unchanged: w from fromBabel\f3_select.npz (runs f51-61, f86-114, f122-200 at w=1 = 119 frames; 8-frame linear ramps -> edited f43-208, 158 frames). Frames with w=0 are byte-identical to sc_ep3.
build_definition.long_axis: AX = principal eigenvector of the covariance of the spoon mesh vertices (body frame), c = vertex mean (same definition as round 1's d2.py jitter split).
build_definition.position_and_axis: per edited frame: a_W = R_W AX, p_W = R_W c + t_W from Wentao's raw camera-frame track W (f3_select.npz W_cam).
build_definition.twist: R_obs = observed right wrist rotation in the camera frame = bundle_merged hand_right_wrist_orient_in_camera after the build's smooth_hand(sigma=2) replicated exactly as in skB3.py. Grip G_f = R_obs_f^T R_W_f; Gm = chordal (SVD-projected) mean of G_f over the right hand's attach hold [43,266) from the scene's report.json attached_1. R_pred_f = R_obs_f Gm. F3w rotation R_f = Rmin(R_pred_f AX -> a_W) R_pred_f (minimal rotation that puts the wrist-predicted long axis onto Wentao's), translation t_f = p_W - R_f c. Wentao's track is used for Gm because it is the track whose axis/position are adopted and it fits the video best (round-1 N1); the chordal mean over 223 frames removes its zero-mean twist jitter (N5).
build_definition.blend: NEW_f = SLERP(OC_f -> F3w_f, w_f) rotation and linear body-origin translation (round-1 blend), OC = adopted scene track in the camera frame.
build_definition.world: scene world pose = (bundle_cleaned c2w + the scene's constant loader offset (0.074563,-0.320921,1.514694), no rotation; round-1 l1/l3) @ NEW_f.

levelling_rule: The build's constant 7.93 deg spoon levelling L is applied inside the windows only if round 1 measured that it RAISES spoon mask IoU for Wentao's track. Round 1 (fromBabel\d1.out) measured switched frames W 0.746 -> WL 0.618 and episode 0.793 -> 0.663, so L is NOT applied inside the windows (F3w uses Wentao's raw axis/position). Outside the windows the adopted track (which carries L from f26 on) is unchanged; the 8-frame ramps SLERP between the two. The T7 risk of undoing a levelling is what G7 guards.
hand_rule: The right hand moves rigidly with the spoon only where it already does: on edited frames inside the right-hand attach hold [43,266) every right-hand world-frame field (robot_right_wrist position/wxyz, robot_right_frames except entry 0 'universe' when it is the identity at the origin on every frame, mano_right_joints, mano_right_joints_wxyz, mano_right_global_orient, mano_right_trans via the root joint, non-zero right contact positions, right contact normals) is mapped by M_f = S_new_f inv(S_old_f), so the hand-in-spoon pose is unchanged. mano_right_scale_center is moved only if its values are world points near the hand (decided by the rule: median distance to the right wrist < 0.3 m), otherwise left unchanged. Left hand, pot, finger joints, contact part ids, mesh radius, meshes, URDFs, support: unchanged.
